The supplied data do not establish that the building can accommodate the required room layout or meet authorization, planning, accessibility, sanitary, fire-safety, or structural requirements; these require verification. The regional 5 sqm per guest standard applies only to specified net-use rooms, not to total property area, and no verified gross-area threshold is provided.
pros: At 1,141.45 sqm, the reported area is well above the requested 360 sqm gross floor area, although the source provides no verified regulatory gross-area threshold.
Energy class B meets the user's preference for class D or better.
Healthcare proximity percentile of 91.75 indicates a strong location match; the central location also has a mobility percentile of 99.44.
cons: The 1929 construction date and energy sub-scores for plant, envelope, and renewables are each 1, so building systems and fabric merit detailed assessment despite class B.
The data do not confirm that the premises can provide the autonomous center's required dedicated rooms, support spaces, and usable-area standards for 18 guests.

Planning compatibility, change-of-use approval, sanitary compliance, accessibility, applicable fire-safety provisions, structural and seismic safety, and sector authorization all require verification.
